stateUnits.blastRadius: all production clusters in one region

resourceMappings.importOrAdopt: resource UID annotation and state import plan

lockingAndSecurity.backend: remote encrypted backend per state unit
lockingAndSecurity.lockRule: one apply writer; lock timeout does not force-unlock without operation evidence
lockingAndSecurity.sensitiveData: state access is privileged and values are not printed to CI logs
lockingAndSecurity.restoreEvidence: quarterly sandbox restore and plan with expected no-op or reviewed drift

planApply.planIdentity: configuration revision + state serial + provider/plugin lock + variable set
planApply.approval: review semantic resource changes and replacement/delete separately
planApply.stalePlanRule: apply rejects if source, state serial or policy evidence changed
planApply.partialFailure: refresh external operation and state before retry

driftPolicy.action: ignore explicit field or adopt declared value

driftPolicy.detect: repeating diff and managed writer evidence
driftPolicy.action: remove duplicate writer or split field ownership

migration.change: split tenant data resources from cluster state

steps.step: backup state and inventory external IDs

migration.rollbackBoundary: before target state writes new provider-managed attributes; otherwise forward repair from snapshots

destroy.stateRemoveMeaning: stops management only and does not delete external resource
destroy.completionEvidence: external API absence or retained ID, credential revoke, cost/orphan scan and final state
